_meta.note: NEW model Hy4-preview (Tencent Hunyuan 4, MoE 770B/49B Gated DSA, 1M ctx, Apache-2.0). Own-column official scores from HF card images (visually verified against the hero chart). Mapped to 26 existing benchmark ids + 4 new STEM benches (MathArena Apex, SUPERChem, BrokenArXiv, HorizonMath). Tencent-internal benches (Hy-*, E-Bench) and vendor-reported competitor columns excluded per strict attribution. GLM-5.3: added ExploitGym 2h budget=105 (only 6h=130 was stored; only net-new value on the GLM-5.3 card, which otherwise fully matched our 24 benches). GlucoFM (Google CGM foundation model, arXiv 2605.30865): NOT added as a scored model — 0.72M-param time-series health model with no LLM-comparable axis; registered as a Resources reference only.

models.name: Hy4 preview
models._note: Tencent Hunyuan 4 early preview. MoE 770B total / 49B active (256 routed + 1 shared, top-8), 78 layers, Gated DeepSeek Sparse Attention + IndexCache, native MTP, 1M ctx, Apache-2.0. Text-focused reasoning model (default effort 'high'). huggingface.co/tencent/Hy4-preview.
